notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with defender.
description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Overgrown Battlement.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Overgrown Battlement.
Repeat.
